changelog: Built and turned on a new sensor that watches the letsBONK launchpad on Solana. Every minute it asks the blockchain for the latest 150 letsBONK transactions and looks for the specific 'graduation' signature (when a token finishes its bonding curve and lists on Raydium). Each match gets logged to a new file (sol_letsbonk_graduation_log.json). This is purely a sensor - it does NOT buy anything yet. The bot needs about 20 logged graduations before it can decide whether trading them is profitable (about 4 days of data at the observed ~5 graduations per day).

Before turning on the sensor, the brain ran a 'smoke test' against a known-good graduation transaction provided by the research brain. The test passed - the sensor extracted the right token from the right transaction. This avoided the kind of silent failure that bit the bot in run-275 (where a sensor looked alive but was logging nothing useful).

The brain also caught a sizing bug before turning the sensor on: at 25 transactions per fetch and the actual letsBONK program throughput of 35 transactions per minute, the sensor would have been blind for ~18 seconds out of every 60-second cycle - missing roughly 30% of graduations by random luck. Raised the per-fetch count to 150, which gives the sensor a 4-minute lookback window with a 4-times safety margin.

No live-trading rules changed this run. The bot's entry/exit logic, position sizing, and risk gates are all identical to run-281. Only thing that changed is one new data sensor running in the background.

new_hypothesis.name: dual_pair_echo_burst
new_hypothesis.mechanism: When a freshly-graduated pump.fun token gets a SECOND independently-created concentrated-liquidity pool (Meteora DLMM at LBUZKduo7ULdJoB1xjkP5VrZv3Q1ZqV4z6HG7Vpzqz, Raydium CLMM, or Meteora DAMMv2) opened within 5 min of its PumpSwap migration BY A WALLET OTHER THAN pump.fun's auto-migrator, that 'echo pair' is a smart-money LP-add — a sophisticated LP'er has scanned the post-graduation chart, decided the token has continuation potential, and is committing capital to capture swap-fee flow before retail bots have indexed the new pair. Their LP-add IS the signal that an informed actor expects more volume. Coupled with buy-dominance >= 1.15 in the post-grad PumpSwap pair over the last 5 min, this is a continuation-leg predictor.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Most copy-trading bots monitor wallet activity and DexScreener boost lists, not cross-DEX pair-creation events. Tracking the exact 'second-pair-created-by-non-pump-migrator-within-5-min' signature requires combining DexScreener's pairs[] array with Solana program-account watching on at least 3 different DEX programs (PumpSwap, Meteora DLMM, Raydium CLMM) — that engineering bar is high enough that this cohort has not been arbed. Also: pump.fun grads ~30-60/day; the echo-pair subset is ~3-8/day, too thin to attract dedicated arb infra.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: (1) Token has a PumpSwap pair created within the last 5-60 min (graduated). (2) DexScreener pairs[] for the mint contains a SECOND pair with dexId in {meteora, raydium-clmm, meteora-damm-v2} created within 5 min of the PumpSwap pair, AND that pair's creator wallet is NOT the pump.fun auto-migrator (need to identify pump.fun migrator address — Phase 1 logger task). (3) PumpSwap pair has buy/sell tx ratio >= 1.15 over the last 5 min and tx count >= 100. (4) Combined liq across all pairs >= $10k. (5) h1 price change still positive at signal time. (6) Standard security gate: RugCheck/GoPlus pass. Position sizing: 0.15x (untested baseline). Stop loss: 8% (standard). Trailing stop: activates at +10% gain, 5% below high-water. Time limit: 60 min hard exit.
new_hypothesis.data_required: (a) DexScreener token endpoint api.dexscreener.com/latest/dex/tokens/<mint> — already used by bot, exposes pairCreatedAt + dexId + liquidity + txns + volume per pair (no extra API). (b) Solana RPC (ALCHEMY_SOLANA_RPC) getTransaction on the new-pair creation sig to identify the LP-add wallet. (c) Optional Phase 2: Birdeye or Solscan to flag if the echo-pair LP creator is also a top-50 holder (alignment check). The LP creator wallet identity is the MOST IMPORTANT discriminator — without it, this strategy can't distinguish informed LP-adds from creator-team manipulation.
